boards.title: Your First Weekend at Kansas State University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented through campus landmarks, culture, study space, recreation, and a local K-State food stop.

cards.title: Start with the campus clocktower
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Anderson Hall
cards.notes: Begin outside the 1879 hall and look up at its tower. Use this recognizable landmark to orient yourself before walking toward the Union.
cards.short_summary: A historic starting point with a bell-filled tower.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State identifies Anderson Hall as a campus building constructed in 1879; its tower contains a 98-bell electronically operated carillon.
cards.access_notes: Plan this as an exterior landmark stop; building access may vary.

cards.title: Get your bearings at the Union
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · K-State Student Union
cards.notes: Walk through the Union, locate the ID Center and Student Programs and Involvement, then save the floor map for later campus errands.
cards.short_summary: A central stop for services, organizations, dining, and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The K-State Student Union’s official building map lists the ID Center, Student Programs and Involvement, dining, bowling, and other services.
cards.access_notes: Services and venues are inside the Union; check individual operations for availability.

cards.title: Choose a campus-made dairy treat
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Call Hall Dairy Bar
cards.notes: Stop at the Dairy Bar for ice cream or another listed dairy product, and check the official page before going because hours differ in breaks.
cards.short_summary: A purchase stop connected to K-State’s dairy operations.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State states that the Call Hall Dairy Bar sells ice cream and other dairy products and publishes school-year and break hours.
cards.source_title: Call Hall Dairy Bar | K-State Animal Sciences and Industry
cards.access_notes: The official page lists school-year hours of 9 a.m.–6 p.m. Monday–Friday and 10 a.m.–5 p.m. Saturday; confirm seasonal changes.

cards.title: Find a quiet seat in the Great Room
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Hale Library
cards.notes: Use the third-floor Great Room for individual reading or planning. Keep conversation low and phones on vibrate in this designated quiet area.
cards.short_summary: A historic reading room set aside for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State Libraries identifies the Great Room on Hale Library’s third floor as a designated quiet study area with abundant study space.
cards.access_notes: Building access follows current Hale Library hours; observe quiet-study expectations.

cards.entity_name: The Gardens at Kansas State University
cards.title: Take an evening garden loop
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · 1500 Denison Ave.
cards.notes: Walk the display gardens and pause at the changing plant collections. Choose the daylight portion of the loop and stay on public paths.
cards.short_summary: A horticultural display garden used as a learning laboratory.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State describes the Gardens as a horticultural display garden and learning laboratory for students and the visiting public; admission and parking are free.
cards.access_notes: Open daily, dawn to 10 p.m., according to the Gardens’ official page.

cards.entity_name: Marianna Kistler Beach Museum of Art
cards.title: See regional art at the Beach Museum
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · 701 Beach Lane
cards.notes: Visit the galleries, then ask the gallery attendant about photography guidance. Personal, non-commercial photos are permitted without flash.
cards.short_summary: A campus art museum with regional and broader collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beach Museum’s official visitor page states that admission and parking are free and permits personal, non-commercial photography without flash.
cards.source_title: Visit | Marianna Kistler Beach Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Tue/Wed/Fri 10 a.m.–5 p.m., Thu 10 a.m.–8 p.m., Sat 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Sun/Mon and holidays.

cards.title: Walk the World War I memorial stadium
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Memorial Stadium
cards.notes: Approach the stadium as a memorial landmark and read its significance. Avoid practice areas and use public routes around the structure.
cards.short_summary: A 1920s campus memorial that now supports student activities.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State states that Memorial Stadium was dedicated in 1929 to honor students and alumni who died in World War I and is now used for band practice, club soccer, and rugby.
cards.source_title: World War I Memorials | Kansas State University
cards.access_notes: Use public exterior routes; field and interior access depend on scheduled activities.

cards.title: Spot the MLK memorial outside Ahearn
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Ahearn Field House
cards.notes: Find the Martin Luther King Jr. memorial bust outside Ahearn, then take in the building’s distinctive field-house exterior from the public walkway.
cards.short_summary: A historic athletics building with a commemorative outdoor bust.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State reports that Martin Luther King Jr. gave his final university speech at Ahearn Field House in 1968 and that a memorial bust was installed outside in 2007.
cards.source_title: Ahearn Field House | K-State campus map
cards.access_notes: Treat this as an exterior landmark stop; facility access varies with athletics and events.

cards.title: Check out the Rec Complex
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · 1831 Olympic Dr.
cards.notes: Tour the public-facing complex with a friend and ask the desk about current eligibility and entry rules before planning a workout or court time.
cards.short_summary: A large campus recreation facility with courts, tracks, climbing, and fitness areas.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State Recreational Services lists courts, climbing and bouldering areas, indoor tracks, fitness areas, and accessible features at the Peters Recreation Complex.
cards.source_title: Peters Recreation Complex | K-State Recreational Services
cards.access_notes: Entry eligibility, guest access, and activity availability are not specified on this facility overview; verify with Recreational Services.

cards.title: End with a look at McCain’s calendar
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · 1501 Goldstein Circle
cards.notes: Check the performance calendar and choose an age-appropriate future program. Confirm ticketing and event details directly before making plans.
cards.short_summary: K-State’s live-performing-arts venue and Music Department home.
cards.evidence_claim: K-State identifies McCain Auditorium as the campus cultural center for live performing arts and notes that it serves students and the general public.
cards.source_title: About McCain Auditorium | Kansas State University
cards.access_notes: Individual performances can have separate ticketing and schedules; consult the official event listing before attending.
